name: activity-chat
title: Activity chat
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A collaboration log with message bubbles, a calendar block, and a voice note whose waveform comes from numeric peaks.

meta.descriptionEs: Burbujas, un bloque de calendario y una nota de voz con onda dibujada a partir de datos.

examples.title: Mesa del taller
examples.description: Enter envía. La nota no tiene archivo de audio.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: Vacío, carga, error, token largo y treinta notas.

meta.usage:
<ActivityChat
  messages={messages}
  people={people}
  currentUserId="mina"
  onSend={(body) => append(body)}
  onPlay={(id) => markPlayed(id)}
/>

api.name: messages / people
api.description: kind is message, event, or voice. TMeta is never read. Entries are ordered by createdAt.

api.name: onSend / onPlay
api.description: onSend gets the trimmed draft. onPlay gets the note id when playback starts.

api.name: currentUserId / locale / timeZone
api.description: Own bubbles sit on the end. Default es-MX and America/Mexico_City.

api.name: loading / error / disabled
api.description: Loading and error replace the log. disabled blocks send and playback.

api.name: labels
api.description: Spanish is the default. activityChatLabelsEn is the English set.

docs: Clean-room thread. Messages, events, and voice notes share one list. onSend receives the trimmed text and does not append it. onPlay fires when a note starts; playback is a local clock over the given duration, not an audio file. Peaks are resampled into a static waveform. Reduced motion skips the entrance and uses an instant scroll. Default locale is es-MX and the default zone is America/Mexico_City. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, button, empty, skeleton, or textarea. The item ships no theme. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied.
